types.name: Collectible Cards
types.desc: Trading cards in 18 themed sets, picked up around Leonida.
how: There are **480 cards** split over **18 sets**, from sports teams to dancers and comics.
Cards are lying around indoors and out. Pick one up and it goes into your collection.
Finishing the **Vice City Flamingos** set (24 cards) unlocks the **Bubblegum** cheat.
Track them under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.

setPages.seoTitle: GTA 6 Vice City Flamingos Card Locations: All 24 and the Bubblegum Cheat
setPages.description: Where to find all 24 Vice City Flamingos collectible cards in GTA 6, in the in-game list order, with a county-by-county plan, a checklist that saves and what finishing the set unlocks (the Bubblegum cheat).
setPages.desc: 24 cards spread over seven counties, from the Keys to Port Gellhorn and the city. Finish it for the Bubblegum cheat.
tips: The list follows the in-game order under **Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards**, so the numbers here match the gaps you see in the menu.
Each player comes in several colours, and **every colour is its own card**: Angel Cienfuegos alone is three cards (Silver, Pink, Blue).
**Watson Bay** has three cards (10, 17 and 21), and **Port Gellhorn** two (1 and 16). Do them in one trip each.
Three spots need a **break-in** (1, 9 and 16) and two are **climbs** to the top of a tower (21, the Watson Bay water tower, and 24, the Ambrosia radio tower).
Your ticks here are shared with the [card checklist](/collectibles/collectible-cards/), the county checklists and the [100% route](/guides/100-percent-route/).

faq.q: How many Vice City Flamingos cards are there in GTA 6?
faq.a: 24. The Vice City Flamingos are one of the 18 card sets (480 cards in all). The numbers on this page follow the in-game list under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.

faq.q: What do you get for completing the Vice City Flamingos set?
faq.a: The **Bubblegum** cheat, a purple and yellow screen filter with sparkles. The set also counts as one of the 3 complete sets for the Don't Touch My Deck trophy and one of the 15 that 100% completion needs.

faq.q: When can you finish the Vice City Flamingos set?
faq.a: From Chapter 3. Six cards are in the Keys (open from Chapter 1) and seven in Kelly and Lummox County (Chapter 2), but the other eleven are in Vice City, Vice Beach, Vice-Dale and Leonard County, which open in Chapter 3.

faq.q: Can you miss any Vice City Flamingos cards?
faq.a: None of the 24 is marked as missable, so you can collect the set at your own pace, including after the story.

types.name: WAiNK Locations
types.desc: Landmarks, sculptures and oddities you scan with the WAiNK app on your phone.
how: Open WAiNK on your phone, point it at the spot and scan.
There are **31 landmarks**, **35 curiosities**, **23 sculptures** and **4 Peewees billboards**, plus the **No Flusher tags** sprayed around town (utility markings). Any 100 count.
The same app scans cars (for the vehicle count) and posters (for the [unique playlists](/collectibles/unique-playlists/)).
Track them under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.

types.seoTitle: GTA 6 1010 Murals: All 5 Locations and the Southside Storage Reward
types.description: All 5 1010 Murals in GTA 6: where to stand for each photo in Downtown, Rockridge, Crosstown and Ocean Beach, and how to open the Southside Storage garage with the 1010 Cheetah inside.
types.desc: Five pieces of street art in Vice City and Ocean Beach. Photograph them all for a hidden garage and a car.
types.reward: Southside Storage garage with the 1010 Cheetah inside (keypad code 1010)
how: There are **5 murals**: two in Downtown, one each in Rockridge, Crosstown and Ocean Beach. Find the spot where the whole artwork is in view and take a photo of it with the phone's camera.
Three are seen from **rooftops**, so use the building's lift or land a helicopter on the roof.
They are **not part of the 100% checklist**, and they don't count as WAiNK scans.
After the first photo the set shows up under Progress, Collections, 1010 Murals.

**The reward:** once all five are done, a garage is marked at the south tip of Salton. It's [Southside Storage](/guides/garages/#southside-storage): enter **1010** on the keypad and the **1010 Cheetah** is inside. Register it to keep it, or sell it.

faq.q: How many meditation spots are there in GTA 6?
faq.a: 18 meditations at 10 locations. Most locations count once for Jason and once for Lucia, and the last one, on the peak of Mount Kalaga, only shows up once all the others are done.

faq.q: How many meditations do you need for 100% and the trophy?
faq.a: The 100% checklist needs 15. The Positive Mental Attitude trophy needs all 18.
Lucia offers one at Jason's house in Chapter 1, after [Down to Earth](/walkthrough/down-to-earth/). It can't be done once Chapter 2 starts, so accept it if she asks.
Fifty meditations unlock the Fast Forward cheat. See the [cheat list](/guides/cheats/).

types.name: Underwater Discoveries
types.desc: Wrecks, research stations, reefs and odd sights on the sea floor. 29 of the 33 are around the Keys.
how: Diving opens with Kenton in [Island Dreams](/walkthrough/island-dreams/) in Chapter 1, which also gives you the metal detector.
Take a boat to the spot and dive. Some boats carry scuba gear on the back: put it on first so you don't run out of air.

**29 of the 33 are in Mariana County**, in the sea around the Keys. The other four are two off Port Gellhorn in Kelly County, one off Gloriana Key and one off Little Hardin Island in Leonard County. Most of the Keys wrecks and reefs have no exact spot on this page yet: turn on the map's Exploration filter and sweep the Keys by boat.

There are four kinds: Kenton's six treasure wrecks, five Burg research facilities, thirteen wrecked ships, planes and a helicopter, and nine reefs, carcasses and sculptures. Use the chips above the list to see one kind.
The three Burg facilities in Mariana County are west of Mile Zero Air Station (south of the Riquezas Keys), just north of Mile Zero Air Station, and east of Key Lento close to Kenton's shop.

The 100% checklist wants all 33. Kenton's two open dive sites, Belpoint Strait and the Bobcat Dive Site, hold treasure for his sets but aren't underwater discoveries. Every set and its pieces are in [Kenton's treasure tracker](/guides/side-contacts/#kenton-treasure).
Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Points of Interest, Underwater Discoveries. On the map, the Exploration filter (magnifying glass) shows them.

faq.q: How many underwater discoveries are there in GTA 6?
faq.a: 33. Twenty-nine are in Mariana County around the Keys, two are off Port Gellhorn in Kelly County, one is off Gloriana Key and one is off Little Hardin Island in Leonard County. The 100% checklist wants all of them.

faq.q: When can you start diving for underwater discoveries?
faq.a: From [Island Dreams](/walkthrough/island-dreams/), Kenton's first job in Chapter 1. It gives you the metal detector, and the first wreck, Nuestra Señora Del Ocio, is part of that mission.
It helps a lot. Some boats carry scuba gear on the back; put it on before you dive so you have enough air to reach the deeper wrecks.

faq.q: Do Kenton's dive sites count as underwater discoveries?
faq.a: His six treasure wrecks do. His two open dive sites, Belpoint Strait and the Bobcat Dive Site, don't, though their treasure still counts toward his sets. See [Kenton's treasure tracker](/guides/side-contacts/#kenton-treasure).

There are five. Three are in Mariana County: west of Mile Zero Air Station (south of the Riquezas Keys), just north of Mile Zero Air Station, and east of Key Lento near Kenton's shop. One is west of Wild Hog Point off the Kelly County coast, and one is far out east of Little Hardin Island in Leonard County.

faq.q: Where do you track underwater discoveries?
faq.a: Under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Points of Interest, Underwater Discoveries. The map's Exploration filter (the magnifying glass) shows them too.

types.name: Basketball Hoops
types.desc: Hoops on courts, driveways and garages all over Leonida. Score one basket at each.
how: Pick up the ball and sink one basket. That logs the hoop.
Every hoop counts once, whoever shoots. Scoring also trains Focus.
Where the 100 are: 18 in Mariana County, 49 across Vice City, Vice Beach and Vice-Dale, 14 in Leonard County, 14 in Kelly County and 5 in Lummox County.

Look for courts first, because one court gives you two hoops and some spots have more: four on two courts under the highway (twice in the city), four in a Leonard County park by a small lake, four on two courts in Kelly County, three on rooftop courts and two on a roof at Washington Beach.
Hamlet Prison has four hoops in its east and west courtyards, and there's one in the yard of Leonida State Prison. A helicopter is the easiest way into Hamlet Prison.
Shooting hoops is also the way into the [basketball challenges](/guides/challenges/).
Track them under Progress, Exploration, Basketball Hoops.
